how_to: فایل را به مترجم بده؛ خروجی را با نام fa-out-quest-westfall-02.json برگردان.
rules: به فارسی روان و معنادار ترجمه کن، نه آوانگاری؛ فقط نام خاص شخص/مکان آوانگاری می‌شود. هر ⟦...⟧ را دقیقاً همان‌طور و به تعداد اصلی نگه دار (جابه‌جایی در جمله مجاز است). عددها را حفظ کن (ارقام فارسی یا لاتین فرقی ندارد). ی و ک فارسی، نیم‌فاصله در «می‌»، «ها» و «ای». هیچ حرف لاتین در خروجی نباشد مگر داخل ⟦...⟧. از glossary برای واژه‌ها پیروی کن. خروجی فقط JSON: {"pack": <همین pack>, "fa": {"<کلید>": "ترجمه"}} با همهٔ کلیدهای rows، نه کم نه زیاد.
tokens_note: ⟦عدد⟧ = کد بازی (نام بازیکن، خط جدید، رنگ). ⟦E..⟧ = نام مصوب؛ معنی‌اش در entities است. هر دو را دست‌نخورده نگه دار.

rows.quest:142:obj:0: Track down the Defias Messenger in ⟦E1⟧ and bring his message to Stoutmantle.
rows.quest:142:details:0: We need to discover the location of the Defias hideout. ⟦1⟧, my scout reports that a Defias Messenger has been seen on the roads between Moonbrook, the Gold Coast Quarry and the Jangolode Mine. I want you to capture him. If he resists, kill him and bring me whatever he is carrying.
rows.quest:142:progress:0: ⟦2⟧, were you able to gather any information? Did you locate the messenger?
rows.quest:142:completion:0: This is indeed firm proof that VanCleef is in charge. Now all we need to know is where the Defias gang is hiding out.
rows.quest:142:completion:1: We've had a stroke of luck while you were gone. We captured a thief trying to steal Saldean's wagon. He has promised to lead us to the hideout in exchange for his life. I want you to defend the traitor so he can reveal the hideout. Return to me once you have uncovered the location.
rows.quest:155:obj:0: Escort the Defias Traitor to the secret hideout of the Defias Brotherhood. Once the Defias Traitor shows you where VanCleef and his men are hiding out, return to Gryan Stoutmantle with the information.
rows.quest:155:details:0: So Stoutmantle sends a scrawny ⟦3⟧ like you to protect me? Guess you'll have to do. Better bring some friends too.
rows.quest:155:details:1: You know the deal, right? You watch my back and I'll take you to the Defias hideout. But you better be close by my side. The Defias gang wants my head now. If they see me with you, they'll try to kill me.
rows.quest:155:details:2: Let me know when you and any friends you can round up are ready to go.
rows.quest:155:progress:0: What business do you have with me? I am a very busy man...
rows.quest:155:completion:0: Most excellent, ⟦4⟧! VanCleef is as good as ours now that we know where he is hiding.
rows.quest:152:obj:0: Kill 7 Tidehunters, 7 Warriors, 7 Oracles and 7 Coastrunners and return to Captain Grayson at the ⟦E1⟧ Lighthouse.
rows.quest:152:details:0: You probably noticed all of the shipwrecks along the coast. The Great Sea is treacherous indeed. The coast of ⟦E1⟧ needs to be kept clear, so that if sailors find their way to our beaches, they are safe. The Murlocs are trouble though.
rows.quest:152:details:1: Kill 7 Tidehunters, 7 Warriors, 7 Oracles and 7 Coastrunners and I will see to it that you are rewarded.
rows.quest:152:progress:0: Kill 7 Tidehunters, 7 Warriors, 7 Oracles and 7 Coastrunners and I will see to it that you are rewarded.
rows.quest:152:completion:0: Well done, ⟦5⟧. You have quite a knack for ⟦E2⟧. Thanks to you the Coast of ⟦E1⟧ is a safer place.
rows.quest:104:obj:0: Bring a scale of Old Murk-Eye to Captain Grayson at the ⟦E1⟧ Lighthouse.
rows.quest:104:details:0: When my life was ended upon the rocks, I had no clue what the afterlife held for me. The Lighthouse was black that night because Old Murk-Eye had scared the keeper's family off. They returned and re-lit the flame but Old Murk-Eye coerced the weaker minded murlocs to ⟦E3⟧ the Lighthouse with him once again. The second time the family was not so lucky and before my eyes they perished helplessly.
rows.quest:104:details:1: Slay Old Murk-Eye if you see him along the shore and bring me one of his scales and I shall reward you.
rows.quest:104:progress:0: Have you laid waste to the menace known as Old Murk-Eye yet? He has been spotted roaming the coastline of ⟦E1⟧.⟦6⟧⟦7⟧Return to me when the foul beast is dead.
rows.quest:104:completion:0: So the foul heathen, Murk-Eye is dead. Well done, ⟦8⟧. By your hands one life was laid to rest but perhaps many more were saved. The Great Sea, wrought with danger as it is, shall be a wee bit safer this night thanks to your heroics.
